title: Islamic Studies Framework
description: A comprehensive framework for mastering Islamic knowledge, from foundational beliefs to advanced research. This framework guides learners through the core pillars of Islam, jurisprudence of daily worship, Quranic sciences, and prophetic biography, culminating in advanced Islamic scholarship.

milestones.title: Beginner Foundations
milestones.description: Build a strong foundation in Islamic beliefs, core practices, and Quranic recitation basics.

milestones.title: Worship Mastery
milestones.description: Deepen understanding of Islamic jurisprudence covering daily prayers, charitable obligations, and the rites of Hajj and Umrah.

milestones.title: Quran & Seerah
milestones.description: Explore Quranic interpretation and the life of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to strengthen spiritual connection and historical understanding.

milestones.title: Advanced Knowledge
milestones.description: Develop advanced skills in Islamic research methodology and Quranic recitation mastery for scholarly pursuits.
